cases.name: native tray menu presents useful actions and an accurate unread summary
cases.scenario: Review the native tray menu implementation. Users need to open or hide the window, see an unread summary, and reach existing diagnostics, settings, and About dialogs. Judge source behavior only; do not claim a native visual or interaction test ran.
rubric: The native menu groups primary access, utility actions, and window or lifecycle actions with separators and clear labels.
Unread title, tooltip, and menu summary handle zero, singular, and large counts without showing message previews or contact names.
Navigation actions show and focus the main window before emitting their known destination, while hide and quit retain their explicit behavior.
Unread updates use the same registered tray and retained native menu item; the menu remains owned for the app lifetime.

cases.name: tray navigation works independently of the sidebar popover
cases.scenario: A tray event arrives while the signed-in sidebar overflow menu is closed, or while a different utility dialog is open. Verify all three destinations can open from the always-mounted component without stacking utility dialogs. Ignore unrelated sidebar presentation.
rubric: The listener is registered in an always-mounted utility component, and settings, diagnostics, and About dialog instances are outside the conditional popover content.
Each known destination opens its matching dialog and closes other utility dialogs; unknown destinations leave state unchanged.
The event listener is cleaned up on unmount, including when asynchronous registration finishes after unmount.
The sidebar About action still opens the same controlled dialog. Do not infer native window activation or signed-out navigation behavior from this frontend source.

cases.name: About supports a controlled tray entry without adding a second trigger
cases.scenario: The always-mounted utility component controls About from a tray action or sidebar action. Review controlled open and close behavior, optional trigger rendering, and preservation of the existing About content.
rubric: Controlled open and onOpenChange support opening and dismissing the dialog, with local state available for existing standalone callers.
The trigger can be hidden without hiding the dialog content, so the external sidebar trigger does not produce a duplicate button.
Version data loads when opened, and the existing update panel and project or license links remain available.
About does not register a tray listener inside conditionally mounted popover content.
